page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.12xlarge is an instance type belonging to the High Clock Speed family, built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a 3.3 GHz baseline clock speed. The server features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with symmetric multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache, backed by support for AVX-512 extensions including VNNI and BF16.

Memory capacity is configured at 192.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmarking yields a PassMark memory score of 2786.2, placing it within the top quartile for memory throughput, complemented by an uncached read bandwidth of 127.79 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 53.45 GB/sec. Compute benchmarks show solid multi-core throughput, including a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 206.4 GB/sec in the top 25%, alongside average-tier scores of 13191.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 49936.52 in stress-ng multi-core testing.

The instance does not bundle any local storage or physical GPUs, requiring reliance on external block storage services for persistent data volumes. Network performance provides a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. Operationally, the server provides high resource density per node, functioning effectively for workloads requiring high clock speeds alongside moderate memory overhead without requiring specialized accelerators.

Workloads well aligned with this hardware configuration include production web serving tiers, software compilation pipelines, batch data processing, distributed caching layers such as Redis clusters, and mid-sized relational database engines requiring strong per-core frequency and reliable memory throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.12xlarge is a high-clock-speed compute instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Powered by dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processors, the server provides 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores, accompanied by 192.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 4:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Architectural features include 33 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 instruction support with VNNI and BF16, and baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps. The configuration does not include discrete GPUs or local disk storage, necessitating remote storage attachment. Benchmark testing demonstrates strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 206.4 GB/sec and upper-quartile PassMark memory responsiveness, combined with steady multi-core results across stress-ng and Geekbench. This hardware footprint is suitable for enterprise web serving, compilation environments, in-memory data processing, and relational database hosting.
